excluded.reason_en: Dorsal-shell-only teaching reconstruction does not satisfy the original whole-organism inventory scope. Primary Fortey & Chatterton (2003) Fig. 1(A–E) anatomy pixels were unavailable for eye/visor review. These are independent blockers.
excluded.reason_zh: 当前仅为背甲教学复原，未满足原始整只生物范围；Fortey 与 Chatterton（2003）图1(A–E)的原始解剖图像未能供眼部与眼罩形态审查。这是两项相互独立的阻塞。
excluded.required_resolution: Separate explicit shell-only scope authorization plus actual figure-pixel review, or a new whole-organism reconstruction against primary anatomy evidence. Figure access alone cannot resolve scope mismatch.
